A set of six small cartoon panels in a 3 × 2 grid, each showing the funny literal picture behind an idiom, to help memory: (1) a cat jumping out of a cloth bag; (2) a student studying at a desk by an old oil lamp at night with a moon at the window; (3) a man standing in a large pot of steaming water, looking worried; (4) a person balanced on top of a wooden fence between two fields; (5) a farmer gripping a bull by its horns; (6) a large white elephant standing in an empty, unfinished stadium. Each panel has a small caption area at the bottom for the idiom. Soft colours, friendly cartoon style, white background.
